_about: The Google Play slide captions, read by node scripts/play-assets.mjs and its caption gate (the same rules as docs/appstore/captions.json: no dashes, exclamation marks, digits, prices, other platforms or billers, nothing a phone does not do, French no-break space before ? ! : ;). One sentence per shot, in upload order. It may wrap on the slide, but only after a comma or a full stop; a sentence with neither may be an array of pieces, and the slide breaks only between them. French takes the typographic apostrophe (’), which the serif draws as an apostrophe rather than a tick. Every language natively read before it ships (2026-10-25 for 1.10.0). Spanish is one neutral set, uploaded under both es-419 and es-ES.

en.today-light: Only today, sized to feel possible.

en.settle-light: A quiet room, for when today gets loud.
